title: Talking about shared free time
instructions: After a 15-second unscored microphone check, record one independent attempt. Answer in order for about 20–30 seconds each. Do not open teaching, write complete answers or re-record before submission. This is a short Part 1 sample, not a complete speaking test. Submit before listening back or viewing feedback.

stimulus.text: Part 1 practice: shared free time. Choose ordinary, non-sensitive examples from family, friends or an imagined household.

questions.prompt: How often do you spend time outdoors with people you know?
What does one person you know usually do on a day off?
Is there a shared activity you enjoy more than you used to? Why?
Would you rather prepare a meal together or visit a cafe together? Why?

criteria.label: Fluency and coherence
criteria.description: Use the actual recording to review continuity, appropriate pauses, repair and logical connections. Describe where the listener could or could not follow the answer. A transcript cannot establish speed, pause length or spoken fluency. Do not reward length or rehearsed linking phrases alone.

criteria.label: Lexical resource
criteria.description: Check whether vocabulary expresses the intended meaning accurately and appropriately, and whether the speaker can paraphrase a missing word. Identify a specific successful choice and one usable alternative; rare vocabulary is not a goal by itself.

criteria.label: Grammatical range and accuracy
criteria.description: Review the structures actually used and whether errors obscure time, relationships or meaning. Quote a short learner-produced example in private feedback and offer one targeted repair. Do not infer range from prompt difficulty.

criteria.label: Pronunciation
criteria.description: Assess only from usable actual audio: intelligibility, word stress, rhythm, connected speech and sounds in context. Note the segment requiring listener effort and a focused practice action. Accent identity is not an error; if audio is missing or unclear, withhold this judgement.

assessment.feedbackGuidance: Only after submission, identify one accurate activity collocation, one clear frequency expression and a reason that explains the actual preference. Review one third-person verb from the audio and one place where the listener lost the message. Plan a later new-family practice rather than labelling a coached repeat as independent evidence. All four qualitative criteria require teacher review; pronunciation and temporal fluency require usable audio. Do not infer a band from this drill or reward a memorised script. If only a transcript is available, withhold audio-dependent judgements.

locale.instructionsFa: پس از بررسی ۱۵ ثانیه‌ای و بدون نمره میکروفن، یک تلاش مستقل ضبط کنید. پرسش‌ها را به ترتیب و هرکدام حدود ۲۰ تا ۳۰ ثانیه پاسخ دهید. پیش از ثبت، آموزش را باز نکنید، پاسخ کامل ننویسید و دوباره ضبط نکنید. این نمونه کوتاه بخش اول است، نه آزمون کامل. پیش از بازشنوی یا دیدن بازخورد، ضبط را ثبت کنید.
locale.feedbackGuidanceFa: فقط پس از ثبت، یک ترکیب درست فعالیت، یک عبارت بسامد روشن و دلیلی مرتبط با ترجیح واقعی را پیدا کنید. یک فعل سوم‌شخص را از روی صدا و یک نقطه قطع ارتباط شنونده را بررسی کنید. تمرین بعدی را با خانواده موضوعی تازه برنامه‌ریزی کنید؛ تکرار پس از راهنمایی، شاهد مستقل نیست. چهار معیار کیفی به بازبینی مدرس نیاز دارند؛ تلفظ و روانی زمانی به صدای قابل استفاده نیاز دارند. از این تمرین بند استنباط نکنید و به متن حفظ‌شده پاداش ندهید. اگر فقط متن دارید، درباره ویژگی‌های وابسته به صدا داوری نکنید.

objectiveMappings.sourceLearningPoint: Develop daily/family activity collocations, present-simple habits and frequency expressions before longer spoken production.
objectiveMappings.unitTeachingConnection: Train constructs activity phrases and switches I to a third-person subject before answering; transfer independently describes shared activities and another person’s routine.
objectiveMappings.taskTransformation: International-student routines and family activity themes become original household/free-time questions; source names, routine texts and answers are excluded.

objectiveMappings.sourceLearningPoint: Distinguish facts, preferences and frequency questions, then extend appropriately with a reason, result or relevant detail.
objectiveMappings.unitTeachingConnection: Train classifies question function and practises because/so links; transfer asks new questions requiring those functions without teaching.
objectiveMappings.taskTransformation: New questions about shared evenings and outings replace source family comparisons; no fixed sentence count is treated as an exam rule.

objectiveMappings.sourceLearningPoint: Use keyword notes and actual listener feedback, including intelligible third-person present endings.
objectiveMappings.unitTeachingConnection: Train uses new /s z ɪz/ examples, then a 30-second message and retry; transfer reviews recorded third-person verbs only after submission.
objectiveMappings.taskTransformation: Source model speech becomes a teacher-modelled micropractice and original learner-generated sentences, not a memorisation script.

notes: Teacher/examiner review required: check prompt accessibility, natural follow-ups, sequencing and suitability for assigned pathway. Pathways are support levels, not calibrated IELTS bands.

Recording must be permitted and usable before spoken assessment; do not send learner audio to an external provider without the agreed consent/data boundary. Local authoring includes no recording or external audio call.

Before timing, provide an unscored microphone check and a clear retry path. Technical failure invalidates timing; retain work privately, mark the attempt interrupted and use a new prompt family for independent evidence. A repeated prompt after coaching is supported practice.

Agree access needs before starting. Permit a neutral topic alternative where personal disclosure would be uncomfortable; mark changed timing or transcript-only work explicitly rather than claiming equivalent independent speech evidence.
Qualitative practice feedback is not a calibrated examiner band. Pronunciation and temporal fluency cannot be assessed from a transcript.

Revision 2 supersedes the held original-only draft. Review source-objective-task fit against the selected Mindset pages; semantic domains and meaningful language practice are adapted, not merely format-cited.
No source model answer or recording is republished. Inspect English/Persian equivalence and use only actual consented recordings for spoken judgement.
No teaching anchors, example answers or formative review before submission. New prompts apply the source objectives within a distinct task family; coached repeat attempts are supported practice.
